import ctypes as c,json,platform,subprocess
cf=c.CDLL('/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreFoundation.framework/CoreFoundation')
vt=c.CDLL('/System/Library/Frameworks/VideoToolbox.framework/VideoToolbox')
obj=c.c_void_p
cf.CFArrayGetCount.argtypes=[obj];cf.CFArrayGetCount.restype=c.c_long
cf.CFArrayGetValueAtIndex.argtypes=[obj,c.c_long];cf.CFArrayGetValueAtIndex.restype=obj
cf.CFDictionaryGetValue.argtypes=[obj,obj];cf.CFDictionaryGetValue.restype=obj
cf.CFNumberGetValue.argtypes=[obj,c.c_long,obj];cf.CFNumberGetValue.restype=c.c_bool
cf.CFBooleanGetValue.argtypes=[obj];cf.CFBooleanGetValue.restype=c.c_bool
cf.CFStringGetCString.argtypes=[obj,obj,c.c_long,c.c_uint32];cf.CFStringGetCString.restype=c.c_bool
cf.CFRelease.argtypes=[obj];cf.CFRelease.restype=None
vt.VTCopyVideoEncoderList.argtypes=[obj,c.POINTER(obj)];vt.VTCopyVideoEncoderList.restype=c.c_int32
vt.VTIsHardwareDecodeSupported.argtypes=[c.c_uint32];vt.VTIsHardwareDecodeSupported.restype=c.c_ubyte
keys={name:obj.in_dll(vt,'kVTVideoEncoderList_'+name).value for name in ['CodecType','EncoderID','IsHardwareAccelerated']}
def text(value):
 if not value:return None
 out=c.create_string_buffer(4096)
 if not cf.CFStringGetCString(value,out,len(out),0x08000100):raise RuntimeError('CFString conversion')
 return out.value.decode()
array=obj();status=vt.VTCopyVideoEncoderList(None,c.byref(array))
if status or not array.value:raise RuntimeError('encoder list status '+str(status))
rows=[]
try:
 for index in range(cf.CFArrayGetCount(array)):
  row=cf.CFArrayGetValueAtIndex(array,index)
  number=cf.CFDictionaryGetValue(row,keys['CodecType']);code=c.c_int64()
  if not number or not cf.CFNumberGetValue(number,4,c.byref(code)):raise RuntimeError('codec type')
  hardware=cf.CFDictionaryGetValue(row,keys['IsHardwareAccelerated'])
  rows.append(dict(codec=int(code.value).to_bytes(4,'big').decode('ascii'),encoder_id=text(cf.CFDictionaryGetValue(row,keys['EncoderID'])),hardware=bool(cf.CFBooleanGetValue(hardware)) if hardware else None))
finally:cf.CFRelease(array)
print(json.dumps(dict(architecture=platform.machine(),system=subprocess.check_output(['sw_vers'],text=True),encoder_list_status=status,encoders=rows,hardware_decoders={code:bool(vt.VTIsHardwareDecodeSupported(int.from_bytes(code.encode(),'big'))) for code in ['avc1','hvc1','av01']},limits='Inventory only; not an encode/decode performance or geometry probe.'),indent=2))
